verdict.rationale: Copilot cloud agent can run on a schedule or in response to repository events such as an issue being opened. It works independently in the background, which covers the core of headless, event-driven automation. An official terminal CLI is also documented, but none of the evidence says it can run non-interactively inside a CI pipeline. Missing for 10: a documented non-interactive or headless CLI mode (e.g. flags or scripting in CI runners or GitHub Actions), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the automations work in practice.
